entities.name: Enrique Hernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Enrique José Hernández González Jr., nicknamed Kike, is a Puerto Rican professional baseball utility player for the Los Angeles Dodgers of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Houston Astros, Miami Marlins, and Boston Red Sox.
